title: Lubrizol advances sulfate-free formulation with new Glucamate Evolve thickener
summary: Lubrizol is launching Glucamate Evolve thickener, a brand new biodegradable, high-performance thickener designed specifically for sulfate-free surfactant systems. According to the company, the ingredient delivers efficient viscosity building, high clarity, enhanced foam quality and fragrance tolerance, enabling formulators to develop cleansing and hair care products combining “mildness, performance and sensory appeal.” With this new development, Lubrizol aims to address evolving...
